comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments, but the constructs differ. Feature 0 counts any specific concrete example or real-world instance, including a named person, event, place or product, or a particular concrete situation. Feature 1 requires specific empirical evidence: statistics, data, study findings, or documented factual cases or observations. Feature 0 would count an anecdote or a named person or product used as an illustration. Feature 1 would not count that unless it is documented empirical evidence. Feature 1 would count aggregate statistics or study findings that are not a single instance. The eligibility rules are materially different, so the extraction functions are not the same.
